ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the seabed topographic profile of the East China Sea on the left, Diaoyu Island is marked near the eastern side of the East China Sea continental shelf; immediately to its east is the clearly subsiding Okinawa Trough, farther east are the Ryukyu Islands, and the far eastern side is marked as the Pacific Ocean. The image on the right shows Diaoyu Island as an island landscape surrounded by sea on all sides. Then reason: the question asks to determine the boundary type according to the theory of plate tectonics. The area where Diaoyu Island is located is near the Okinawa Trough–Ryukyu island arc tectonic belt, and this belt is related to the subduction and consumption of an oceanic plate toward the continental margin; subduction and consumption correspond to a plate destructive boundary. Therefore, Diaoyu Island is located at a plate destructive boundary.

图中左图为东海底地形剖面图，右图为我国钓鱼岛照片。读图回答：

<image1>

从板块构造学说的理论来说，钓鱼岛位于哪种板块边界？
raw_record.final_cot: First describe the image: in the seabed topographic profile of the East China Sea on the left, Diaoyu Island is marked near the eastern side of the East China Sea continental shelf; immediately to its east is the clearly subsiding Okinawa Trough, farther east are the Ryukyu Islands, and the far eastern side is marked as the Pacific Ocean. The image on the right shows Diaoyu Island as an island landscape surrounded by sea on all sides. Then reason: the question asks to determine the boundary type according to the theory of plate tectonics. The area where Diaoyu Island is located is near the Okinawa Trough–Ryukyu island arc tectonic belt, and this belt is related to the subduction and consumption of an oceanic plate toward the continental margin; subduction and consumption correspond to a plate destructive boundary. Therefore, Diaoyu Island is located at a plate destructive boundary.
